resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record says standing. The register says the tower is believed to be out of service as of 2025. Both can hold if the tower still stands but is no longer used. The story uses the register's wording.

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR page describes this tower in text. The 2015 Commons photo is matched to the register's location by our own comparison of coordinates, not by its caption, so treat it as likely rather than confirmed. No build date, staffing or access terms were found. Florida Memory item 326330 (a Florida Forest Service building and fire observation tower) returned 403 and was not read. The photo's upload path was confirmed to resolve (image/jpeg, HTTP 200).
